privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what information Cosmecos collects when you use our shop, what we use it for, and how you can have it deleted.

sections.title: What we collect
paragraphs: Your account: your name, email address and password. The password is stored only in encrypted (hashed) form, so nobody can read it — not even us.
Your orders: the products you buy, your delivery address and phone number, and your order history.
Anything else you add to your profile, such as a phone number or a saved address.

sections.title: Signing in with Google
paragraphs: If you sign in with Google, we receive only your name and email address, plus an account identifier from Google so we can recognise you the next time. We never see your Google password and get no access to your Gmail, contacts or anything else in your Google account.

sections.title: How we use it
paragraphs: We use your information only to run your account, to process and deliver your orders, and to send you the emails the shop needs, such as verification and password reset codes.

sections.title: Who we share it with
paragraphs: We never sell your personal information or share it for advertising.
It is stored and processed only by the services we need to run the shop — website hosting, our database and email delivery — and only for that purpose.

sections.title: Your browser
paragraphs: We keep your sign-in session and your language choice in your browser’s local storage. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

sections.title: Deleting your account
paragraphs: You can delete your account yourself at any time: open your profile and choose “Delete account”. Your account, bag, wishlist and messages are deleted straight away.
Orders you placed stay in our records for accounting, but your name, email, phone number and address are removed from them, so they no longer identify you.
If you can no longer sign in, write to the address below from the email of your account, and we will delete it for you.
